title: Direct and Lightweight execution preserve the fast path
userIntent: Keep ordinary bounded reads and local commands off durable lifecycle machinery while retaining bounded terminal evidence and deterministic mutation ownership.

intendedBehavior: Readonly and short bounded repository commands use Direct/Lightweight execution.
Fast execution creates no ExecutionJob, Local Job, Worker, scheduler wake, or projection invalidation.
Concurrent mutation ownership remains serialized and recoverable without promoting ordinary work into durable execution.
behavioralInvariants: Duration alone does not make ordinary checks durable.
Fast-path commands remain cancellable and bounded.
Lightweight terminal evidence may survive completion without replaying running commands.
regressionRisks: Reintroducing durable jobs for ordinary local commands.
Writing leases or projections on the readonly fast path.

provenance.note: Final exact-main convergence acceptance scenario added by Plan S4; the immutable snapshot is the S3-integrated main revision.
